name: Absorb LMS
description: Absorb LMS is a cloud-based learning management system with a REST API for managing learners, courses, certificates, departments, enrollments, and tracking e-learning completion data.

hasPart.name: Absorb Integration API
hasPart.description: REST-based interface for integrating external systems with Absorb LMS. Supports user management, course management, enrollment processing, certificate tracking, department administration, and e-learning completion data.

hasPart.name: Absorb SCIM API
hasPart.description: Implements the SCIM 2.0 standard for seamless user and group provisioning through standardized endpoints, enabling automated identity lifecycle management in Absorb LMS.

hasPart.name: Absorb Infuse API
hasPart.description: Enables developers to embed Absorb LMS learning experiences directly within external applications. Requires a paid add-on license for access.
